theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), MeasurableSet M → CountablyRectifiable (n + 1) M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[n + 1] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ G : Euclid P → Euclid P, Measurable G ∧ (∀ x, ‖G x‖ ≤ L) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n + 1].restrict M), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt (n + 1) M x (approxTangentPlane (n + 1) M x) ∧ G x ∈ approxTangentPlane (n + 1) M x ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μHE[n + 1] (M ∩ ball x r ∩ {y | ε * ‖y - x‖ < |f y - f x - inner ℝ (G x) (y - x)|}) / ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (n + 1))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)) ∧ (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖ * g x ∂μHE[n + 1]) ∧ ∀ᵐ t, CountablyRectifiable n (M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t})), G x ≠ 0 ∧ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) x (approxTangentPlane (n + 1) M x ⊓ (ℝ ∙ G x)ᗮ)
